verdict.reason: The passage says NCEP/CPC shifted to a Relative Oceanic Niño Index effective February 1, 2026, but explicitly says the “legacy Niño 3.4 and Oceanic Niño Index files will continue to be updated.” It does not say the 30-year-baseline ONI was retired, that it “struggles to keep pace” with warming, or that past events were reclassified.
